title: the DSG combat rules for underground play - the fighting on walls and sheer surfaces, on bridges and ledges, the grabbing-an-enemy system, the fighting in water with the grappling modification, the fighting in narrow passages, the fighting and spellcasting in darkness, and the mounted combat with Table 14 and the dismount tactics

banner.title: The DSG COMBAT RULES FOR UNDERGROUND PLAY, R507: the printed pp. 30-33 (pdf 31-34; printed p. 31 = pdf 32 is the full-page combat illustration plate - the chapter text runs pp. 30 and 32-33 with the plummet-to/the-fate cut spanning the plate) - the fighting on walls and other sheer surfaces (the AC bonus loss, the flat -2, the elevation modifiers, the damage-forced Climbing Check, the dropped boulders), the fighting on bridges and ledges (the 5-foot rule, the hit-forced Dex Check, the push modifiers), the grabbing-an-enemy system (the 2-foot bar, the 1d20 vs AC 10, the -20% hanging checks, the rating assignments), the fighting in water (the depth ladder, the -4/-4, the exemptions) with the grappling-in-water modification, the fighting in narrow passages (the DMG frontage), the fighting in darkness (the -4/+4 set, the wild swing, the Dex/climbing cuts), the spellcasting in darkness (Table 9, the clue modifier), and the mounted combat (the species rules, the +1, the bow fire with Table 14 and the 45-degree limit) with the forcing-opponents-to-dismount tactics.
banner.provenance: the DSG scan (archive.org item advanced-dungeons-dragons-1st-edition), pdf = printed + 1; the text read from the IA djvu OCR with the pdf Acrobat-Capture layer as the second read - every numeric cell dual-confirmed (Table 14 cell-for-cell: -1/-3/-5 both layers); the -10% climbing-check modifier is the % glyph OCR class (the 96 garble) and agrees const-for-const with the WSG half-hit-points pin; the clumsy-creature rating floor 0 carries the one residual caution (the % glyph unreadable, value 0 certain); the cross-book seam verified const-for-const against rules/wsgfight.h (R488) and the landed dmv/dmx/dnp DSG headers - NOTHING auto-credited; the seven flagged divergences (the bridge Dex-per-foot sign, the wall penalty frame, the elevation frame, the water depth ladder, the darkness penalty set, the mounted rate of fire, the bridge trigger) pinned as printed under the DSG prefix.
banner.sentinel: The Table 14 speed bands encode as 0 (less than 1/2 normal), 1 (1/2 to less than 3/4), 2 (3/4 to maximum); the modifiers are the die-roll convention (-1/-3/-5). The grid sentinel is -99 with no NA cells (census 0/0). The DSG-internal cross-references (Table 9 course changes, the p. 12 holding-breath rules, the p. 23 proficiency rules) pin as page-number consts.

audit_comment: The DSG combat rules for underground play pins the wall fighting (the shield-and-Dex AC bonus loss, the flat -2 attack/damage/save penalty, the +2 higher / -2 lower elevation modifiers, the damage-forced Climbing Check with the -10% half-hit-points modifier, the 3-foot 2d8 boulder at AC 10 with the -8 cannot-hurl penalty), the bridge and ledge fighting (the 5-foot drop-off rule, the hit-forced Dex Check at +2 Dex per foot from the drop-off, the +2 back-to-wall / -2 back-to-drop-off push modifiers), the grabbing-an-enemy system (the under-2-foot-weapon bar, the 1d20 grab vs AC 10 with the weapon dropped, the Climbing/Dex Check to avoid joining the fall, the -20% hanging regain and hit checks, the separate-immediately fall, the 80-95/70/0 rating assignments), the water fighting (the none-below-waist / halved-to-chest / full-above-chest ladder, the -4 attack and -4 damage at floor 1, the native and swimming-proficiency exemptions) with the grappling-in-water modification (the UA pp. 106/108 references, the 1/3-height depth bar, the paralysis save for a breath, the p. 12 holding-breath rules), the narrow-passage bottleneck (the DMG pp. 69-70 frontage), the darkness fighting (the flat -4 attack/save/damage with +4 AC at floor 1, the forfeited sight bonuses, the infravision/magic/light exemptions, the twice-weapon-length wild swing at modified 0-or-less with the count-and-roll discipline, the Dex -2 and Climbing -10% drop-off cuts), the spellcasting in darkness (the Table 9 secret roll, the -1 to -3 clue modifier), the mounted combat (the trained-and-appropriate-species rules, the +1 mounted-vs-foot, the exact-hit-strikes-mount, the bow fire with the halved rate of fire and Table 14, the 45-degree firing-round limit, the DMG p. 53 flying penalties) and the dismount tactics (the slain-mount 1d3 fall with the proficiency check, the natural-20 3-foot unseat, the 5-9-foot and 10-foot foot soldiers at 16-20/25%, the dive grapple at 1d6, the -2 rider-vs-grappler).

consts.name: dnqWallAtkDmgSavePenalty
consts.comment: the flat -2 penalty assessed to all attack, damage, and save rolls on a sheer surface (the WSG splits cliff -2 attacks and saves / severe slope -1 attacks - the DSG adds damage rolls and drops the slope distinction, pinned as printed).

consts.name: dnqWallHigherAtkBonus
consts.comment: the higher character gains a +2 to-hit modifier in addition to all others that apply.

consts.name: dnqWallLowerAtkPenalty
consts.comment: the lower character suffers a -2 modifier to his attack rolls.

consts.name: dnqWallHalfHpCheckPenalty
consts.comment: the -10% modifier to the Climbing Check on a half-or-more total-hit-points hit (the % glyph OCR class; agrees const-for-const with the WSG wfcBigDamageCheckPenalty).

consts.name: dnqBoulderDiameterFt
consts.comment: the average-sized boulder is three feet in diameter.

consts.name: dnqBoulderDamageDice
consts.comment: the boulder inflicts 2d8 points of damage: two dice.

consts.name: dnqBoulderDamageSides
consts.comment: the boulder damage die: d8.

consts.name: dnqBoulderCannotHurlPenalty
consts.comment: if the creatures dropping the missile cannot pick it up and hurl it (as a giant could), they suffer a -8 modifier to their attack roll.

consts.name: dnqBridgeDropoffWithinFt
consts.comment: the rule applies if some sort of drop-off is located within five feet of the character.

consts.name: dnqBridgeDexPerFoot
consts.comment: the Dexterity for the check is increased by two for every foot of distance between the character's feet and the drop-off (OPPOSITE SIGN to the WSG edge rule, which reads -2 per foot - the round's true cross-book divergence, pinned as printed).

consts.name: dnqBridgeBackToWallDex
consts.comment: in melee a character with his back to a wall receives a +2 modifier to his Dexterity.

consts.name: dnqBridgeBackToDropoffDex
consts.comment: a character with his back to a drop-off receives a -2 penalty.

consts.name: dnqBridgePushMod
consts.comment: the push modifier is a + or -2 to Dexterity, applied in addition to all other modifiers.

consts.name: dnqGrabWeaponMaxFt
consts.comment: the grab-eligible weapon length bar: less than two feet.

consts.name: dnqGrabAttackDie
consts.comment: the grab attempt is a normal attack roll on 1d20 that would hit the other character.

consts.name: dnqGrabAcBase
consts.comment: the target is AC 10 minus Dexterity bonuses.

consts.name: dnqHangingRegainCheckPenalty
consts.comment: the hanging character can make a Climbing Check with a -20% modifier to regain his hold on the wall or his footing on the ledge.

consts.name: dnqClingHitCheckPenalty
consts.comment: any successful hit on the clinging character requires another Climbing Check with a -20% modifier.

consts.name: dnqNaturalClimberRatingLo
consts.comment: the natural-climber band floor: monkeys, spiders and other natural climbers fall into the 80-95% range.

consts.name: dnqNaturalClimberRatingHi
consts.comment: the natural-climber band ceiling: 95%.

consts.name: dnqGoatLlamaRating
consts.comment: mountain goats and llamas might rate 70%.

consts.name: dnqClumsyRatingFloor
consts.comment: clumsier creatures could rate as low as 0 (the OCR caution cell: the % glyph unreadable, the value 0 certain).

consts.name: dnqWaterAttackPenalty
consts.comment: attacks by creatures not at home in water suffer a -4 penalty on the 1d20 attack roll.

consts.name: dnqWaterDamagePenalty
consts.comment: a successful water attack suffers a -4 modifier to the damage it would normally inflict.

consts.name: dnqWaterDamageFloor
consts.comment: water-modified damage can be reduced to no less than 1 point.

consts.name: dnqWaterGrappleUaPage
consts.comment: the grappling-in-water modification is for use with the Weaponless Combat System listed on page 106 of Unearthed Arcana.

consts.name: dnqWaterGrappleDepthNum
consts.comment: the depth fraction numerator: 1/3 of the victim's height.

consts.name: dnqWaterGrappleDepthDen
consts.comment: the depth fraction denominator: 1/3.

consts.name: dnqWaterGrappleHoldPage
consts.comment: the hold-broken explanation sits on page 108 of Unearthed Arcana.

consts.name: dnqWaterGrappleBreathRefPage
consts.comment: the Holding Breath section on page 12 of the DSG gives the length of time a character can hold his breath.

consts.name: dnqNarrowDmgFrontagePage
consts.comment: page 69 of the DMG provides the combat-frontage description.

consts.name: dnqNarrowDmgFrontagePage2
consts.comment: page 70 of the DMG completes the combat-frontage description.

consts.name: dnqDarkAttackPenalty
consts.comment: the -4 penalty to all attack rolls for characters who cannot see (the WSG splits -3 natural / -4 total on attacks only - the DSG flat -4 agrees with the total-dark value, pinned as printed).

consts.name: dnqDarkSavePenalty
consts.comment: the -4 penalty to all saving throws in darkness.

consts.name: dnqDarkDamagePenalty
consts.comment: the -4 penalty to all damage rolls in darkness.

consts.name: dnqDarkAcPenalty
consts.comment: the +4 penalty to Armor Class in darkness.

consts.name: dnqDarkDamageFloor
consts.comment: even with the penalties, a successful attack cannot cause less than 1 point of damage.

consts.name: dnqDarkWildSwingThreshold
consts.comment: if the attack roll misses with a modified result of 0 or less, the attack has unintentionally struck another object.

consts.name: dnqDarkWildSwingRadiusMult
consts.comment: any object closer to the character than twice his weapon's length may be hit.

consts.name: dnqDarkDexCheckPenalty
consts.comment: the Dexterity reduction near a drop-off or on a sheer surface in darkness: -2 (agrees with the WSG total-dark precarious modifier).

consts.name: dnqDarkClimbingCut
consts.comment: the Climbing Rating reduction in darkness: -10% (agrees with the WSG total-dark climbing cut).

consts.name: dnqDarkSpellCourseTable
consts.comment: the DSG course-changes table consulted for spells cast in darkness: Table 9 (landed R505 as the dmx darkness grid).

consts.name: dnqDarkSpellClueModLo
consts.comment: the clue modifier floor: -1.

consts.name: dnqDarkSpellClueModHi
consts.comment: the clue modifier ceiling: -3.

consts.name: dnqMountedVsFootBonus
consts.comment: the +1 modifier on all attack rolls made by a mounted character against an opponent who is not mounted.

consts.name: dnqMountedRofExampleFromNum
consts.comment: the rate-of-fire example numerator: a character who normally attacks at 2/1.

consts.name: dnqMountedRofExampleFromDen
consts.comment: the rate-of-fire example denominator: 2/1.

consts.name: dnqMountedRofExampleToNum
consts.comment: the mounted rate for the 2/1 archer: 1/1 (the DSG halves the rate - the WSG one-step-down-the-scale rule reads 2/1 to 3/2; the divergence is pinned as printed).

consts.name: dnqMountedRofExampleToDen
consts.comment: the mounted rate denominator for the 2/1 archer: 1/1.

consts.name: dnqMountedRofSecondFromNum
consts.comment: the second rate example: a rate of 3/1.

consts.name: dnqMountedRofSecondToNum
consts.comment: the mounted rate for the 3/1 archer: 3/2.

consts.name: dnqMountedRofSecondToDen
consts.comment: the mounted rate denominator for the 3/1 archer: 3/2, etc.

consts.name: dnqFireRoundTurnLimitDeg
consts.comment: the most the mount can turn during the firing round is 45 degrees to either side of its current direction.

consts.name: dnqFlyingDmgRefPage
consts.comment: the DMG page for the flying-steed missile penalties: 53.

consts.name: dnqMountDeathFallDmgDice
consts.comment: the failed-or-unproficient dismount fall damage: 1d3 - one die.

consts.name: dnqMountDeathFallDmgSides
consts.comment: the dismount fall damage die: d3.

consts.name: dnqUnseatWeaponMinFt
consts.comment: the unseat attempt requires a melee weapon of three feet or greater length wielded by another mounted character.

consts.name: dnqUnseatNaturalDie
consts.comment: the unseat attempt requires an attack roll of natural 20.

consts.name: dnqUnseatNoProfExtraDmgSides
consts.comment: the unproficient unseat victim suffers an additional 1d3 points of damage.

consts.name: dnqFootUnseatShortMinFt
consts.comment: fighters on foot armed with weapons of five to nine feet have the same chance of unhorsing riders as mounted attackers.

consts.name: dnqFootUnseatShortMaxFt
consts.comment: the foot-soldier short-weapon ceiling: nine feet.

consts.name: dnqFootUnseatLongMinFt
consts.comment: foot soldiers using weapons of 10 feet or greater lengths have a 25% chance of dismounting riders.

consts.name: dnqFootUnseatLongPct
consts.comment: the long-weapon dismount chance: 25%.

consts.name: dnqFootUnseatLongDieLo
consts.comment: the long-weapon dismount roll: 16-20 on the attack roll.

consts.name: dnqFootUnseatLongDieHi
consts.comment: the long-weapon dismount roll ceiling: 20.

consts.name: dnqDiveMissFallDmgSides
consts.comment: the missed-dive fall damage: 1d6.

consts.name: dnqDiveBothFallDmgSides
consts.comment: the both-fall damage: 1d6 each.

consts.name: dnqRiderGrapplerAtkPenalty
consts.comment: all rider attacks against a grappling opponent are made with a -2 modifier to hit (the WSG pins the permission but not the -2 - a DSG-only value).

consts.name: dnqT14RowCount
consts.comment: the Table 14 Mounted Bow Fire grid: three speed bands.

bools.name: dnqOpenerUnusualTerrain
bools.comment: the rules cover melee and missile combat in unusual underground terrain.

bools.name: dnqOpenerSheerWallExample
bools.comment: the suspended-midway-up-a-sheer-wall example.

bools.name: dnqOpenerNarrowBridgeExample
bools.comment: the poised-atop-a-narrow-bridge example.

bools.name: dnqOpenerSwimmingAttacked
bools.comment: the swimming-character-attacked example.

bools.name: dnqOpenerDarknessClarification
bools.comment: additional clarification of the effects of darkness follows.

bools.name: dnqOpenerBattlesystemTail
bools.comment: the section closes with instructions and modified rules for the AD&D Battlesystem Fantasy Combat Supplement in the constricted conditions of the underearth.

bools.name: dnqWallNoShieldDexAcBonus
bools.comment: a climbing character loses all Armor Class bonuses from shield or Dexterity.

bools.name: dnqWallFaceToSurfaceBackExposed
bools.comment: a character whose face is toward the surface presents his back to any attacker.

bools.name: dnqWallBackExposedExceptAdjacent
bools.comment: except an attacker next to him on the wall.

bools.name: dnqWallOneSideOrOther
bools.comment: such a character can only face a foe to one side or the other.

bools.name: dnqWallOneHandHoldsOn
bools.comment: at least one hand is needed to hold on.

bools.name: dnqWallNoMultipleWeapons
bools.comment: the character cannot use multiple weapons.

bools.name: dnqWallAboveBelowModifiers
bools.comment: if combatants are above or below their opponents during a wall fight, specific modifiers apply.

bools.name: dnqWallSecurePlaceMayCancel
bools.comment: a place of some security reached before combat may cancel some or all of the penalties (the DM's judgment).

bools.name: dnqWallArcherLedgeExample
bools.comment: the archer who carefully selects a ledge from which he can easily see his targets and draw his bow fires normally.

bools.name: dnqWallBoulderSwordsmanExample
bools.comment: the swordsman firmly balanced on a large boulder has the advantage over opponents scrambling up to reach him.

bools.name: dnqWallDamageClimbingCheck
bools.comment: a character on a sheer surface struck for any amount of damage must make an immediate Climbing Check.

bools.name: dnqWallCheckFailFalls
bools.comment: the check succeeds: the character remains in place; it fails: the character falls.

bools.name: dnqWallHalfHpTrigger
bools.comment: the damage-inflicted modifier applies when the damage is equal to or greater than 1/2 of the character's total hit points.

bools.name: dnqWallHalfHpRoundedUp
bools.comment: the half-total-hit-points figure is rounded up.

bools.name: dnqWallBoulderTactic
bools.comment: creatures defending a wall or cliff often roll or drop heavy objects onto attackers below.

bools.name: dnqBoulderVictimAcTen
bools.comment: all victims are treated as AC 10 for purposes of these attacks.

bools.name: dnqBoulderKnocksOffClimbers
bools.comment: victims climbing a sheer cliff could be knocked off by this attack, as given by the fall rules.

bools.name: dnqBridgeStandWithoutHands
bools.comment: the bridges-and-ledges situations assume the character has room to stand somewhere without using his hands to hold on.

bools.name: dnqBridgeHitPenaltiesOnly
bools.comment: all the difficulties relate to hits against the character; there are no penalties for attacking in this situation.

bools.name: dnqBridgeHitForcesDexCheck
bools.comment: a character hit by any attack that causes a loss of hit points or consciousness (such as a sleep spell) must make a successful Dexterity Check to avoid falling over the nearby drop-off.

bools.name: dnqBridgePushTowardAway
bools.comment: the Dexterity is also modified if the force of the blow pushes the character toward or away from the drop-off.

bools.name: dnqBridgeMissilePathIndicator
bools.comment: during missile combat the path of the missile serves as a good indicator of whether a character is pushed toward or away from a drop-off.

bools.name: dnqBridgeArrowExample
bools.comment: the character on a narrow bridge struck by an arrow from his left side is propelled toward the drop-off on his right.

bools.name: dnqBridgeLedgeExample
bools.comment: the character on a ledge with his back to the wall and enemies before him is pushed back toward the wall by any blow.

bools.name: dnqGrabCloseQuartersOnly
bools.comment: the grab rule is used when a character is fighting in extremely close quarters and falls from a sheer surface or a narrow ledge or bridge.

bools.name: dnqGrabOrGrappling
bools.comment: the rule is only used when at least one character fights with a weapon of less than two feet, or when the characters are grappling.

bools.name: dnqGrabOneAttempt
bools.comment: the falling character can make one attempt to grab his enemy as he falls.

bools.name: dnqGrabNoArmorShieldBenefit
bools.comment: the target receives no benefit for armor or shield.

bools.name: dnqGrabNoWeaponMagicBonus
bools.comment: no magical bonuses for weapons apply to the grab attack roll.

bools.name: dnqGrabWeaponMustDrop
bools.comment: any weapon held must be dropped for the attempt to be made.

bools.name: dnqGrabSuccessGrabsBody
bools.comment: on a successful roll the character has grabbed some part of his opponent's body.

bools.name: dnqGrabbedWallClimbingCheck
bools.comment: the grabbed character rolls a Climbing Check if on a wall.

bools.name: dnqGrabbedLedgeDexCheck
bools.comment: the grabbed character rolls a Dexterity Check on a ledge or bridge.

bools.name: dnqGrabbedCheckFailBothFall
bools.comment: if the check fails, both characters plummet to the fate that awaits them below.

bools.name: dnqGrabbedCheckSuccessRetains
bools.comment: if the check succeeds, the grabbed character retains his position, with his opponent clinging tenuously to his leg (or whatever).

bools.name: dnqHangingCannotAttack
bools.comment: the character hanging onto his opponent cannot make any attacks.

bools.name: dnqHangingRegainSuccess
bools.comment: a successful regain check: the character has regained his place.

bools.name: dnqHangingFailStaysClinging
bools.comment: an unsuccessful regain check: the character remains clinging desperately to his opponent.

bools.name: dnqClingOpponentAttacksNormally
bools.comment: the opponent can attack the clinging character normally.

bools.name: dnqClingCheckFailFalls
bools.comment: failure on the hit check means the clinging character falls and his opponent remains on the wall.

bools.name: dnqClingOtherCauseBothFall
bools.comment: if anything else causes the character retaining his hold to fall, both characters fall.

bools.name: dnqFallingGrappledSeparate
bools.comment: even if characters are grappled together when they fall, they separate immediately.

bools.name: dnqFallingSpellPossible
bools.comment: a magic-user might be able to cast a spell before hitting the bottom while his less fortunate opponent plummets to a hard landing.

bools.name: dnqAssignRatingToCreatures
bools.comment: when characters fight creatures without Climbing Ratings or Dexterity Scores, the DM assigns a Climbing Rating based on natural abilities or lack thereof.

bools.name: dnqWaterBelowWaistNoPenalty
bools.comment: standing in water less than waist deep: none of the combat penalties apply.

bools.name: dnqWaterWaistToChestHalved
bools.comment: water waist deep to chest deep: the penalties are halved.

bools.name: dnqWaterAboveChestOrSwimFull
bools.comment: swimming or standing in water above the chest: the penalties are fully in effect.

bools.name: dnqWaterInterferesWithFighting
bools.comment: water interferes with the fighting effectiveness of characters and creatures not bred for that environment.

bools.name: dnqWaterNativeExempt
bools.comment: any creature that spends part of its life in the water is not penalized while fighting in it.

bools.name: dnqWaterSwimProfExempt
bools.comment: a character with swimming proficiency is not penalized while fighting in the water.

bools.name: dnqWaterGrapplePullUnder
bools.comment: using these rules, characters can attempt to pull their opponents underwater and hold them under until they drown.

bools.name: dnqWaterGrappleDepthRule
bools.comment: a grappling-in-water attack can only be successful in water at least 1/3 of the victim's height.

bools.name: dnqWaterGrappleNoWeaponPenalties
bools.comment: the grapple attempt can be made without the penalties that would apply to an attack with a weapon.

bools.name: dnqWaterGrappleBothGoUnder
bools.comment: if the grapple is successful, both characters go under the surface of the water.

bools.name: dnqWaterGrappleAttackerBreath
bools.comment: the grappling character is assumed to have taken a deep breath of air (as per the swimming rules) before going under.

bools.name: dnqWaterGrappleVictimParalysisSave
bools.comment: the grappled character must make a saving throw vs. paralyzation to get such a breath of air.

bools.name: dnqWaterGrappleNoBreathIfFailed
bools.comment: a failed save means the character is assumed to have been dragged under before he could take a breath.

bools.name: dnqWaterGrappleUnderUntilHoldBroken
bools.comment: the characters remain underwater until the hold is broken.

bools.name: dnqNarrowBottleneckTactic
bools.comment: a common defensive barrier in caves is the bottleneck passage where only one or two characters can hold off a mob of attackers.

bools.name: dnqNarrowOneOrTwoHolders
bools.comment: only one or two characters hold off the mob at a bottleneck.

bools.name: dnqNarrowLimitsAttackers
bools.comment: the bottleneck tactic limits the number of enemies that can attack at once.

bools.name: dnqNarrowMonstersNpcsToo
bools.comment: the bonus is usable by monsters and NPCs as well.

bools.name: dnqNarrowDefensiveOrAggressive
bools.comment: the location can be used defensively as protection from the enemy's attacks or aggressively as a means of striking the enemy at an advantage.

bools.name: dnqNarrowRoomForAllRequired
bools.comment: the side claiming the bonus must have sufficient room for all fighting individuals to use their weapons without interfering with each other.

bools.name: dnqDarkCannotSeeRisks
bools.comment: characters who cannot see in the dark run serious risks when participating in combat: greatly reduced success, the chance of wounding an ally or striking an obstacle, and treacherous terrain features such as cliffs, pits or pools.

bools.name: dnqDarkForfeitsSightBonuses
bools.comment: all bonuses that require a character to see his victim are forfeited.

bools.name: dnqDarkForfeitExamples
bools.comment: the forfeited-bonus examples: a ranger's bonuses against giants, a thief's backstab attack, and a vorpal sword's beheading function.

bools.name: dnqDarkInfravisionExempt
bools.comment: the penalties do not apply to characters with infravision.

bools.name: dnqDarkMagicWeaponExempt
bools.comment: the penalties do not apply to characters wielding magical weapons.

bools.name: dnqDarkLightSourceExempt
bools.comment: the penalties do not apply to characters within range of any source of light.

bools.name: dnqDarkWildSwingObjects
bools.comment: a cannot-see character within twice his weapon length of any ally, other opponents, walls, chairs or other obstacles stands a chance of striking one of these instead of his target.

bools.name: dnqDarkWildSwingCountRoll
bools.comment: count up all the objects within the weapon's reach, then roll randomly to determine which is hit.

bools.name: dnqDarkDropoffDexCheck
bools.comment: a cannot-see character fighting next to a drop-off or on a sheer surface has his Dexterity reduced for purposes of all Dexterity Checks to see if he falls over the drop-off.

bools.name: dnqDarkClimbingCheckCut
bools.comment: the Climbing Rating is reduced for purposes of all Climbing Checks in darkness.

bools.name: dnqDarkSpellOffTargetRisk
bools.comment: if a spellcaster cannot see the target of his spell, there is a chance the spell might affect something besides the intended target.

bools.name: dnqDarkSpellPlayerIndicates
bools.comment: the player must indicate exactly where the spell is targeted.

bools.name: dnqDarkSpellDmSecretRoll
bools.comment: the DM then makes a secret roll on Table 9: Course Changes in Darkness to determine where the spell really goes off.

bools.name: dnqDarkSpellClueMods
bools.comment: if the spellcaster has a clue to the location of the target (noise or smell, for example), the DM may assign a modifier to the Table 9 roll.

bools.name: dnqMountCavalryRareUnderground
bools.comment: the sweeping charges of vast ranks of cavalry are not as common in the realms of the Underdark as upon the surface.

bools.name: dnqMountUnderdarkStables
bools.comment: many of the races living beneath the surface maintain a stable of appropriate mounts.

bools.name: dnqMountTrainedRequired
bools.comment: a steed must have been trained for combat to function as a mount during it.

bools.name: dnqMountSpeciesAppropriate
bools.comment: the steed must be of a species appropriate to such combat.

bools.name: dnqMuleInappropriate
bools.comment: mules are inappropriate combat mounts.

bools.name: dnqMuleLackSpeedManeuverFearless
bools.comment: the mule disqualifiers: lack of speed, maneuverability, and fearlessness.

bools.name: dnqHorseTrainableUnderground
bools.comment: horses can be trained to fight in underground conditions.

bools.name: dnqHorseReliesOnSight
bools.comment: horses rely heavily on the sense of sight.

bools.name: dnqHorseUnusableTotalDark
bools.comment: horses are unusable in situations of total darkness.

bools.name: dnqUnderdarkSteedList
bools.comment: steeds employed by the races of the Underdark include griffons, nightmares, dire wolves, giant striders, giant lizards, and rothe.

bools.name: dnqHorseIlluminationPermits
bools.comment: horses are used if illumination permits.

bools.name: dnqHorseNightRaids
bools.comment: horses are especially favored for raiding parties that venture onto the surface during the dark of night.

bools.name: dnqMountedHeightAdvantage
bools.comment: the mounted character's height advantage serves to protect him from opponents' attacks and gives him an advantage when he attacks.

bools.name: dnqExactHitStrikesMount
bools.comment: when the character standing on the ground attacks, any roll that exactly equals the number needed to hit strikes the mount instead of the mounted character.

bools.name: dnqExactHitOnlyIfRiderTarget
bools.comment: the exact-hit procedure is only used if the rider is the intended victim.

bools.name: dnqChooseMountTarget
bools.comment: a character can always choose to attack the mount instead of the rider.

bools.name: dnqMountedBowFormidable
bools.comment: mounted bowmen create a formidable force, combining speed with the ability to attack from a distance.

bools.name: dnqMountedBowRideShootRide
bools.comment: a mounted archer can often ride close to his enemy, shoot an arrow, and ride away again before the enemy can react.

bools.name: dnqMountedBowStationaryNoPenalty
bools.comment: any character can fire a bow from a mount that is not moving, without negative modifiers.

bools.name: dnqMountedBowMovingNeedsHorsemanship
bools.comment: to shoot from a moving steed the character must have horsemanship proficiency.

bools.name: dnqMountedBowMovingNeedsBowProf
bools.comment: to shoot from a moving steed the character must also have a bow weapon proficiency.

bools.name: dnqMountedBowBothHandsKnees
bools.comment: the character needs both hands to fire the bow and thus must guide his mount with his knees.

bools.name: dnqMountedBowTerrainBar
bools.comment: the DM can rule that terrain because of steepness, slipperiness or very rough ground requires the character to hold the reins, preventing mounted bow fire.

bools.name: dnqShortbowAllowed
bools.comment: shortbows can be fired by mounted characters.

bools.name: dnqCompositeShortbowAllowed
bools.comment: composite shortbows can be fired by mounted characters.

bools.name: dnqLightCrossbowAllowed
bools.comment: light crossbows can be fired by mounted characters.

bools.name: dnqMountedRofLessThanUnmounted
bools.comment: the mounted rate of fire is less than when unmounted.

bools.name: dnqMountedSpeedPenaltyTable
bools.comment: the character also suffers penalties to hit based on the speed of the mount at the time the attack is made, as shown on Table 14: Mounted Bow Fire.

bools.name: dnqT14Cumulative
bools.comment: the Table 14 modifiers are cumulative with all others that apply.

bools.name: dnqFireRoundNoManeuvers
bools.comment: during the round he fires, the rider cannot perform maneuvers with his mount, except for slight turning.

bools.name: dnqSlightTurningOnly
bools.comment: only slight turning is permitted while firing.

bools.name: dnqSharperTurnsRequireHold
bools.comment: sharper turns and complicated maneuvers require the character to hold on and prevent the use of a bow.

bools.name: dnqMountedRulesAllMounts
bools.comment: these rules apply to riders on all types of mounts.

bools.name: dnqFlyingAdditionalPenalties
bools.comment: if the steed is flying, additional penalties apply as listed in the DMG, page 53, under Aerial Missile Fire.

bools.name: dnqDismountEvensOdds
bools.comment: special tactics evolved to allow opponents on the ground to even the odds with the mounted warrior.

bools.name: dnqDismountRiderStunnedProne
bools.comment: knocking the rider off more than evens the odds: the rider is generally stunned, injured, or at the very least prone after falling from his mount.

bools.name: dnqDismountMethodsHeroicOrGrim
bools.comment: there are several methods for dismounting an opponent, some heroic and others merely grim and efficient.

bools.name: dnqSlayMountMostDirect
bools.comment: by far the most direct method is to slay the mount.

bools.name: dnqSlayMountSteedLost
bools.comment: the disadvantage to slaying the mount: it is no longer useful to anyone.

bools.name: dnqCaptureSteedBetter
bools.comment: in many cases it is more beneficial to try to remove the rider and capture the steed.

bools.name: dnqMountDeathAutoFall
bools.comment: if a steed is killed while a character is mounted upon it, the character automatically falls to the ground.

bools.name: dnqMountDeathProfCheckLandsFeet
bools.comment: a character with horsemanship proficiency (the proficiency rules, page 23) is entitled to a Proficiency Check to see if he lands on his feet.

bools.name: dnqMountDeathContinueActing
bools.comment: on a successful check the character remains upright and can continue to act normally, even attacking that same round if he has not attacked yet.

bools.name: dnqMountDeathNoFurtherFunctions
bools.comment: the fallen character can perform no further functions that round.

bools.name: dnqMountDeathNextRoundToFeet
bools.comment: the fallen character must spend the entire next round climbing to his feet.

bools.name: dnqUnseatKnockChance
bools.comment: when the natural-20 hit lands, there is a chance the victim is knocked from his mount.

bools.name: dnqUnseatNoProfAutoFall
bools.comment: a rider without horsemanship proficiency is automatically knocked to the ground.

bools.name: dnqUnseatProfCheckRetains
bools.comment: a rider with horsemanship proficiency is allowed a Proficiency Check; success retains his seat with no ill effects beyond the damage caused by the attack.

bools.name: dnqUnseatCheckFailFalls
bools.comment: a failed unseat Proficiency Check drops the character with the effect previously noted.

bools.name: dnqFootUnseatRidersSameBothWays
bools.comment: riders have the same chance of remaining in the saddle in both instances.

bools.name: dnqFootUnseatLongCheckAllowed
bools.comment: riders with horsemanship proficiency are allowed a check to remain in the saddle against the long-weapon dismount.

bools.name: dnqDiveByMounted
bools.comment: a mounted attacker can attempt to dive on another rider by moving adjacent to him and leaping from the saddle.

bools.name: dnqDiveSuccessGrapples
bools.comment: a successful dive attack roll means the attacker has grappled the other rider.

bools.name: dnqDiveMissAttackerFalls
bools.comment: a missed dive attack roll drops the attacker to the ground.

bools.name: dnqDiveVictimProfCheck
bools.comment: the grappled rider may be allowed a check against his horsemanship proficiency.

bools.name: dnqDiveCheckSuccessStays
bools.comment: a successful check means the grappled character remains in the saddle with the other character hanging from his side.

bools.name: dnqDiveCheckFailBothFall
bools.comment: if the check is not allowed or fails, both characters fall to the ground.

bools.name: dnqDiveRepeatSubsequentRounds
bools.comment: if the rider remains mounted with his attacker clinging to him, the procedure is repeated in subsequent rounds.

bools.name: dnqClingNeedsToHit
bools.comment: to keep his place, the attacker must successfully roll to hit each round.

bools.name: dnqClingRiderRechecks
bools.comment: on each cling hit the rider must make another Proficiency Check to remain in the saddle.

bools.name: dnqRiderMayAttackGrappler
bools.comment: a rider can use a weapon to attack a grappling opponent.

tables.name: Table 14: MOUNTED BOW FIRE
col_comments: the mount-speed band: 0 = less than 1/2 normal, 1 = 1/2 to less than 3/4 normal, 2 = 3/4 to maximum speed.
the modifier to hit by band: -1, -3, -5 (agrees const-for-const with the WSG mount-speed penalties wfcMountSlow/Mid/FastPenalty).
tables.audit_comment: the Table 14 mounted bow fire grid

examples.note: the Table 14 slow band: less than 1/2 normal speed, -1 to hit.
the Table 14 mid band: 1/2 to less than 3/4 normal speed, -3 to hit.
the Table 14 fast band: 3/4 to maximum speed, -5 to hit.
the Table 14 bands run contiguously 0-1-2.
the Table 14 penalty ladder steps by -2 each band: -1, -3, -5.
the half-hit-points Climbing Check penalty is -10% (agrees with the WSG wfcBigDamageCheckPenalty).

examples.expr: m['dnqBoulderDiameterFt']() != 3 or m['dnqBoulderDamageDice']() != 2 or m['dnqBoulderDamageSides']() != 8 or m['dnqBoulderCannotHurlPenalty']() != 8
examples.note: the dropped boulder: three feet in diameter, 2d8 damage, -8 if it cannot be hurled.
the bridge rule: drop-off within 5 feet, +2 Dex per foot of distance, the push modifier plus-or-minus 2.
the bridge per-foot bonus equals the push modifier: both 2.
the back-to-wall +2 and the back-to-drop-off -2 Dex modifiers.
the grab: under-2-foot weapon bar, the 1d20 attack, AC 10.
the hanging -20% regain check and the hit-while-clinging -20% check.
the two -20% grab checks are the same number.

examples.expr: m['dnqNaturalClimberRatingLo']() != 80 or m['dnqNaturalClimberRatingHi']() != 95 or m['dnqGoatLlamaRating']() != 70 or m['dnqClumsyRatingFloor']() != 0
examples.note: the assigned climbing ratings: natural climbers 80-95%, goats and llamas 70%, clumsy creatures as low as 0.
the water penalties: -4 attack, -4 damage, floor 1 point.
the water attack and damage penalties are the same 4.
the grappling-in-water references: UA pp. 106 and 108, the DSG Holding Breath p. 12.
the grappling depth bar: 1/3 of the victim's height.
the narrow-passage frontage reference: DMG pp. 69 and 70.

examples.expr: m['dnqDarkAttackPenalty']() != 4 or m['dnqDarkSavePenalty']() != 4 or m['dnqDarkDamagePenalty']() != 4 or m['dnqDarkAcPenalty']() != 4 or m['dnqDarkDamageFloor']() != 1
examples.note: the darkness penalties: -4 attack, save and damage, +4 AC, floor 1 point.

examples.expr: m['dnqDarkAttackPenalty']() != m['dnqDarkSavePenalty']() or m['dnqDarkSavePenalty']() != m['dnqDarkDamagePenalty']() or m['dnqDarkDamagePenalty']() != m['dnqDarkAcPenalty']()
examples.note: all four darkness penalties are the same 4.

examples.expr: m['dnqDarkWildSwingThreshold']() != 0 or m['dnqDarkWildSwingRadiusMult']() != 2 or m['dnqDarkDexCheckPenalty']() != 2 or m['dnqDarkClimbingCut']() != 10
examples.note: the darkness wild swing: modified 0-or-less within twice weapon length; the drop-off Dex -2 and Climbing -10%.
the spell-in-darkness roll: Table 9 course changes, the clue modifier -1 to -3.
the mounted-vs-foot attack bonus: +1.

examples.expr: m['dnqMountedRofExampleFromNum']() != 2 or m['dnqMountedRofExampleFromDen']() != 1 or m['dnqMountedRofExampleToNum']() != 1 or m['dnqMountedRofExampleToDen']() != 1 or m['dnqMountedRofSecondFromNum']() != 3 or m['dnqMountedRofSecondToNum']() != 3 or m['dnqMountedRofSecondToDen']() != 2
examples.note: the mounted rate of fire: 2/1 fires at 1/1, 3/1 becomes 3/2.
the firing-round turn limit 45 degrees; the flying-steed penalties at DMG p. 53.
the slain-mount fall 1d3 and the unseat extra 1d3.
the slain-mount fall die equals the unseat extra die: both d3.
the unseat attempt: 3-foot-or-greater weapon, natural 20.

examples.expr: m['dnqFootUnseatShortMinFt']() != 5 or m['dnqFootUnseatShortMaxFt']() != 9 or m['dnqFootUnseatLongMinFt']() != 10 or m['dnqFootUnseatLongPct']() != 25 or m['dnqFootUnseatLongDieLo']() != 16 or m['dnqFootUnseatLongDieHi']() != 20
examples.note: the foot-soldier unseat weapons: 5-9 feet at the natural 20, 10 feet or more at 25% (16-20).
the dive grapple: 1d6 falls both ways, the rider attacks the grappler at -2.
the dive miss-fall die equals the both-fall die: both d6.
the wall-fight modifiers: flat -2 to attack, damage and saves; +2 higher / -2 lower.
the wall elevation bonus and penalty are the same 2.

table_checks.note: the Table 14 carries three speed bands.

table_checks.expr: m['dnqT14Band'](0) != 0 or m['dnqT14Mod'](0) != -1 or m['dnqT14Band'](1) != 1 or m['dnqT14Mod'](1) != -3 or m['dnqT14Band'](2) != 2 or m['dnqT14Mod'](2) != -5
table_checks.note: the Table 14 grid cell-for-cell: bands 0-1-2, modifiers -1/-3/-5.
